<script id="ml-session-clarity-v3">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  function sessionState(start, now){
    if(!Number.isFinite(start)) return 'unknown';
    if(now >= start + 60 * 60000) return 'ended';
    return now >= start ? 'started' : 'upcoming';
  }
  function init(){
    var root=document.getElementById('ml-tickets'); if(!root) return;
    var forms=Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('form[data-ml-start]'));
    var layout=root.querySelector('.ml-ticket-layout'); if(!layout || !forms.length) return;
    var nav=document.createElement('section'); nav.className='ml-session-shortcuts';
    nav.setAttribute('aria-label','Seans saatini seçin');
    var title=document.createElement('p');title.textContent='Seans saatini seçin · Saatler Türkiye saatidir';
    var list=document.createElement('div'); nav.append(title,list);layout.before(nav);
    forms.forEach(function(form){
      var status=document.createElement('p');status.className='ml-session-status';status.setAttribute('role','status');
      form.querySelector('h3').after(status);
      var button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';
      var time=document.createElement('strong');time.textContent=form.dataset.mlTime;
      var label=document.createElement('small');button.append(time,label);list.append(button);
      button.addEventListener('click',function(){form.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});form.querySelector('h3').focus({preventScroll:true});});
      form.querySelector('h3').setAttribute('tabindex','-1');
      form.mlStatusElement=status;form.mlTimeButton=button;form.mlTimeLabel=label;
    });
    function refresh(){
      var now=Date.now(), city=location.hash.slice(1), any=false;
      forms.forEach(function(form){
        var start=Date.parse(form.dataset.mlStart),state=sessionState(start,now);
        var active=form.dataset.mlCity===city;
        form.classList.toggle('ml-session-started',state==='started');
        var message=state==='started'?'Seans başladı · Başlangıç saati geçti. Bilet almadan önce seans saatinizi kontrol edin; sonraki seansı aşağıdan seçebilirsiniz.':state==='ended'?'Seans tamamlandı':'Başlamadı · Bu seansın başlangıç saati henüz gelmedi.';
        if(form.mlStatusElement.textContent!==message)form.mlStatusElement.textContent=message;
        form.mlTimeButton.hidden=!active;
        form.mlTimeButton.style.display=active?'flex':'none';
        form.mlTimeButton.dataset.state=state;
        form.mlTimeButton.disabled=state==='ended';
        form.mlTimeButton.setAttribute('aria-label',form.dataset.mlTime+' — '+(state==='started'?'Seans başladı':state==='ended'?'Tamamlandı':'Seansa git'));
        form.mlTimeLabel.textContent=state==='started'?'Seans başladı':state==='ended'?'Tamamlandı':'Seansa git ↓';
        if(active && state!=='ended')any=true;
      });
      nav.hidden=!any;nav.style.display=any?'block':'none';
    }
    refresh();window.addEventListener('hashchange',refresh);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',refresh);setInterval(refresh,15000);
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init,{once:true});else init();
})();
</script>
